summary: Carefully executed, well‑documented preregistered paired study of a verifier‑guided generate→validate→repair pipeline vs LLM‑alone on a synthetic multi‑vendor NetOps task family. Artifacts, hashes, and provenance are comprehensively archived. Primary confirmatory analysis finds a small, nonstatistically significant paired success‑rate improvement (Δ ≈ 0.01596; 95% bootstrap CI [0.0, 0.03723]; McNemar p = 0.25). The preregistered efficacy threshold (≥20 pp) was not met. Repair invocations were rare (3) and correspond to the three guarded‑only successes. The manuscript transparently discloses limitations including high baseline correctness (ceiling effect), verifier scope, and missing finalized stratified tables in the supplied snapshot.
required_revisions: Report the prespecified sensitivity analysis per the preregistration ("complete_pair_primary_with_failure_as_zero_sensitivity"): compute and report the paired estimand, exact test p‑value and 95% bootstrap CI when failed episodes are treated as failures/regressions, or explicitly document why that prespecified sensitivity was not executed. This result must be derived from the archived raw_results and analysis artifacts and added to the manuscript or an appendix within the supplied five pages (or by compressing other nonessential text).

Add an explicit mapping in the manuscript (or in a one‑paragraph boxed supplement within pages 1–5) that lists the exact episode identifiers and the provider_call filenames (and their SHA‑256 checksums) corresponding to the three repair invocations (the three guarded‑only successes). The execution/raw_results.jsonl and execution/provider_calls/ directory contain these entries; include them so readers can deterministically locate the per‑call traces referenced in the text.
optional_revisions: If space permits, include a compact stratified table (by preregistered topology_scale and vendor_mix) summarizing complete pairs and discordant counts per stratum (the task_manifest contains the required metadata). If page limits prevent full tables, add a one‑sentence pointer with explicit file offsets/line ranges or precise jq/python extraction examples so reviewers can reproduce strata counts deterministically from the archived manifest.

Add a short (≤1 paragraph) quantitative summary of blast‑radius metrics or repair content for the three repair‑invocation episodes (e.g., number of commands changed, touched interfaces) drawn from validator_trace fields, or else state that low repair count prevents meaningful aggregate blast‑radius inference.

State explicitly in Methods (one sentence) how the estimator reported (paired success‑rate difference) maps to the preregistered phrasing (regression‑rate reduction), and include a short note in the abstract that clarifies the executed estimand to avoid any reader confusion.
